name: Anisotropic Spatiotemporal Filtering Optimizer
aliases: Anisotropic Spatiotemporal Filtering Optimizer — Cross-bilateral filter optimizer
definition: An optimizer that extends Adam by applying spatial filters to gradients and moments to exploit spatial coherence, performing non-diagonal preconditioning.
summary: The Anisotropic Spatiotemporal Filtering Optimizer accelerates inverse rendering by applying an edge-preserving cross-bilateral filter to gradients, avoiding the oversmoothing of isotropic methods.
